goal: Widen the author check-in window to sixty minutes and the author-lease cap to one hour (default grant unchanged at thirty minutes) so a check-in taken before CI is still valid when the guarded merge job runs, with every ceiling message derived from the constants, the rulebook synced, and the truth-audit disposition catalogue refreshed.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken any guarded-merge revalidation: claim, lease, head, collisions and freeze checks stay exactly as strong.
Do not raise the default fresh-claim lease above thirty minutes.
Do not touch any migration or database object.
assumptions: The sixty-minute liveness tradeoff is owner-authorized (Albert, 2026-10-23: "we need the merge lane to accept an author check-in older than 10 minutes old").
stop_conditions: Any test pinning the old bounds fails after the widening.
The guarded merge lane refuses a fresh check-in under the new window.
